title: IAT Pairing-Position Identification Analysis
description: Reproducibility package supporting the study Pairing and block position are not separately identified in the Implicit Association Test: consequences for group comparisons. The repository contains analysis scripts, public-data acquisition and preparation code, compact numerical outputs, dependency specifications, and documentation. Raw and participant-level data are not redistributed.
